title: Primitive-vector lowering formulas for a finite-dimensional sl2 module
statement:
Let $K$ be a field of characteristic zero, $A$ a $K$-Lie algebra, and $M$ a finite-dimensional $K$-vector space with a Lie representation $ho:A	o\operatorname{End}_K(M)$ [def-wf-lie-algebra]. Let $h,e,f\in A$ satisfy $h
e0$, $[e,f]=h$, $[h,e]=2e$, and $[h,f]=-2f$. Put $E=ho(e)$ and $F=ho(f)$. If $0
e v\in M$ and $\mu\in K$ satisfy $Ev=0$ and $ho(h)v=\mu v$, then there exists $N\in\mathbf N$ with $\mu=N\cdot1_K$. For every such $N$, one has $F^iv
e0$ for $0\le i\le N$, and for every $j\in\mathbf N$ one has $$EF^{j+1}v=(j+1)(\mu-j)F^jv,$$ where natural numbers in the formula are mapped to $K$.
